definition: the top part of your body, with your face at the front
exampleSentence: I have a pain in my head.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau đầu.

definition: the front part of your head, with your eyes, nose and mouth
exampleSentence: Wash your face before dinner.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rửa mặt trước bữa tối.

definition: the thin threads that grow on your head
exampleSentence: My hair is black and short.
exampleTranslation: Tóc tôi đen và ngắn.

definition: the part of your face above your eyes
exampleSentence: Put your hand on my forehead.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đặt tay lên trán tôi.

definition: one of the two parts of the body you see with
exampleSentence: I have brown eyes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi có đôi mắt nâu.

definition: the line of hair above your eye
exampleSentence: My teacher raised one eyebrow.
exampleTranslation: Thầy cô tôi nhướng một bên lông mày.

definition: one of the small hairs along the edge of your eyelid
exampleSentence: There is an eyelash in my eye.
exampleTranslation: Có một sợi lông mi trong mắt tôi.

definition: one of the two parts on your head that you hear with
exampleSentence: My ears are cold.
exampleTranslation: Tai tôi lạnh cóng.

definition: the part of your face used for smelling and breathing
exampleSentence: I have a cold and my nose is red.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị cảm và mũi tôi đỏ lên.

definition: the soft round part of your face below your eye
exampleSentence: The baby has soft cheeks.
exampleTranslation: Em bé có đôi má mềm mại.

definition: the part of your face used for eating and speaking
exampleSentence: Open your mouth, please.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn há miệng ra.

definition: one of the two soft edges of your mouth
exampleSentence: My lips are dry in winter.
exampleTranslation: Môi tôi bị khô vào mùa đông.

definition: the soft part in your mouth that you use to taste and speak
exampleSentence: Don't burn your tongue on the soup.
exampleTranslation: Đừng để canh làm bỏng lưỡi bạn.

definition: one of the hard white parts in your mouth that you bite with
exampleSentence: I brush my teeth twice a day.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đánh răng hai lần một ngày.

definition: the firm pink flesh in your mouth around your teeth
exampleSentence: My gums bleed when I brush my teeth.
exampleTranslation: Nướu của tôi chảy máu khi tôi đánh răng.

definition: one of the two bones in your face that hold your teeth
exampleSentence: The ball hit me on the jaw.
exampleTranslation: Quả bóng đập vào hàm tôi.

definition: the part of your face below your mouth
exampleSentence: My uncle has a small beard on his chin.
exampleTranslation: Chú tôi có chòm râu nhỏ trên cằm.

definition: hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks
exampleSentence: My uncle has a long beard.
exampleTranslation: Chú tôi có bộ râu dài.

definition: hair that grows on a man's upper lip
exampleSentence: My uncle has a grey moustache.
exampleTranslation: Chú tôi có bộ ria màu xám.

definition: the part of your body between your head and shoulders
exampleSentence: My neck hurts after sleeping.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau cổ sau khi ngủ dậy.

definition: the passage at the back of your mouth, going down your neck
exampleSentence: I have a sore throat.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau họng.

definition: the part of your body where your arm joins your neck
exampleSentence: I carry my bag on my shoulder.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đeo túi trên vai.

definition: one of the two long parts of your body between your shoulders and hands
exampleSentence: I broke my arm last year.
exampleTranslation: Năm ngoái tôi bị gãy tay.

definition: the joint where your arm bends
exampleSentence: Don't put your elbows on the table.
exampleTranslation: Đừng chống khuỷu tay lên bàn.

definition: the part of your body where your hand joins your arm
exampleSentence: I wear my watch on my wrist.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đeo đồng hồ ở cổ tay.

definition: the part at the end of your arm, with fingers and a thumb
exampleSentence: Please wash your hands.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rửa tay đi.

definition: the inside surface of your hand
exampleSentence: Show me the palm of your hand.
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi xem lòng bàn tay của bạn.

definition: one of the long thin parts of your hand
exampleSentence: I cut my finger with a knife.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị dao cắt vào ngón tay.

definition: the short thick finger at the side of your hand
exampleSentence: I hurt my thumb with the hammer.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị búa đập vào ngón tay cái.

definition: a hand with the fingers tightly closed
exampleSentence: Make a fist with your hand.
exampleTranslation: Hãy nắm bàn tay lại.

definition: the hard flat part at the end of your finger
exampleSentence: I bite my fingernails when I am nervous.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cắn móng tay khi lo lắng.

definition: the front part of your body between your neck and stomach
exampleSentence: I have a pain in my chest.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau ở ngực.

definition: the part of your body behind you, from your neck to your waist
exampleSentence: My back hurts after sitting all day.
exampleTranslation: Lưng tôi đau sau khi ngồi cả ngày.

definition: the organ in your body where food goes, or your belly
exampleSentence: I have a pain in my stomach.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau bụng.

definition: your stomach, the front part of your body below your chest
exampleSentence: The baby has a round belly.
exampleTranslation: Em bé có cái bụng tròn.

definition: stomach, used especially by or to children
exampleSentence: My tummy hurts.
exampleTranslation: Bụng tôi đau.

definition: the small round mark in the middle of your stomach
exampleSentence: Babies have a small belly button.
exampleTranslation: Em bé có cái rốn nhỏ.

definition: the narrow part in the middle of your body
exampleSentence: This belt is too big for my waist.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc thắt lưng này quá rộng so với eo tôi.

definition: one of the two parts at the sides of your body below your waist
exampleSentence: Put your hands on your hips.
exampleTranslation: Hãy chống tay lên hông.

definition: the hollow place under your arm where it joins your body
exampleSentence: My shirt is wet under my armpit.
exampleTranslation: Áo tôi bị ướt ở chỗ nách.

definition: the joint in the middle of your leg
exampleSentence: I fell and hurt my knee.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị ngã và đau đầu gối.

definition: the front part of your leg between your knee and foot
exampleSentence: The ball hit me on the shin.
exampleTranslation: Quả bóng đập vào ống chân tôi.

definition: the back part of your leg between your knee and ankle
exampleSentence: My calf hurts after the run.
exampleTranslation: Bắp chân tôi đau sau khi chạy.

definition: the joint between your foot and your leg
exampleSentence: I twisted my ankle yesterday.
exampleTranslation: Hôm qua tôi bị trẹo cổ chân.

definition: the part of your body that you stand and walk on
exampleSentence: My feet are cold.
exampleTranslation: Chân tôi lạnh.

definition: one of the five movable parts at the end of your foot
exampleSentence: I hit my toe on the door.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị va ngón chân vào cánh cửa.

definition: one of the hard parts that form the frame of your body
exampleSentence: I broke a bone in my foot.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị gãy một cái xương ở bàn chân.

definition: a part of your body that can bend, where two bones meet
exampleSentence: My knee joint hurts when I walk.
exampleTranslation: Khớp gối của tôi đau khi tôi đi bộ.

definition: a piece of flesh in your body that you use to move
exampleSentence: He has strong arm muscles.
exampleTranslation: Người đó có cơ tay rất khỏe.

definition: the bones of a person's head
exampleSentence: The skull protects the brain.
exampleTranslation: Hộp sọ bảo vệ não.

definition: one of the curved bones around your chest
exampleSentence: I hurt a rib when I fell.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau một xương sườn khi ngã.

definition: the row of bones down the middle of your back
exampleSentence: Sit up straight to protect your spine.
exampleTranslation: Hãy ngồi thẳng để bảo vệ cột sống.

definition: a part of the body, such as the heart, with a special purpose
exampleSentence: The heart is an important organ.
exampleTranslation: Tim là một cơ quan quan trọng.

definition: the organ in your chest that pumps blood
exampleSentence: My heart beats fast when I run.
exampleTranslation: Tim tôi đập nhanh khi tôi chạy.

definition: one of the two organs in your chest that you breathe with
exampleSentence: Smoking is bad for your lungs.
exampleTranslation: Hút thuốc có hại cho phổi.

definition: the organ in your head that controls how you think and move
exampleSentence: The brain controls the whole body.
exampleTranslation: Bộ não điều khiển cả cơ thể.

definition: one of the two organs in your lower back that clean your blood
exampleSentence: You have two kidneys.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có hai quả thận.

definition: a tube that carries blood to your heart
exampleSentence: The nurse found a vein in my arm.
exampleTranslation: Y tá tìm thấy một mạch máu ở tay tôi.

definition: a thin thread in your body that carries messages to and from the brain
exampleSentence: This nerve sends pain to the brain.
exampleTranslation: Dây thần kinh này gửi cảm giác đau lên não.

definition: the red liquid that your heart pumps around your body
exampleSentence: There was blood on my finger.
exampleTranslation: Có máu trên ngón tay tôi.

definition: the whole physical structure of a person
exampleSentence: Exercise is good for your body.
exampleTranslation: Tập thể dục tốt cho cơ thể.

definition: the air that you take into or send out of your lungs
exampleSentence: Take a deep breath.
exampleTranslation: Hãy hít một hơi thật sâu.

definition: to take air into your lungs and send it out again
exampleSentence: It is hard to breathe in this room.
exampleTranslation: Rất khó thở trong căn phòng này.

definition: the sound you make when you speak or sing
exampleSentence: I lost my voice after the concert.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị mất giọng sau buổi hòa nhạc.

definition: the liquid produced in your mouth
exampleSentence: Saliva helps you to digest food.
exampleTranslation: Nước bọt giúp tiêu hóa thức ăn.

definition: drops of salty liquid that come out of your skin when you are hot
exampleSentence: Sweat ran down my face.
exampleTranslation: Mồ hôi chảy xuống mặt tôi.

definition: a drop of salty liquid that comes from your eye when you cry
exampleSentence: A tear ran down my cheek.
exampleTranslation: Một giọt nước mắt lăn xuống má tôi.

definition: to notice or look at something using your eyes
exampleSentence: I can see a bird in the tree.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nhìn thấy một con chim trên cây.

definition: to know that a sound is being made, using your ears
exampleSentence: I can't hear you. Please speak louder.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không nghe thấy bạn. Làm ơn nói to hơn.

definition: to notice a smell with your nose
exampleSentence: I can smell fresh bread.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngửi thấy mùi bánh mì mới nướng.

definition: to put your hand or finger on something
exampleSentence: Don't touch the hot pan.
exampleTranslation: Đừng chạm vào cái chảo nóng.

definition: to experience a physical feeling or emotion
exampleSentence: I feel tired today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay tôi cảm thấy mệt.

definition: having little or no hair on your head
exampleSentence: My grandfather is bald.
exampleTranslation: Ông tôi bị hói.

definition: greater in height than normal
exampleSentence: My brother is very tall.
exampleTranslation: Anh trai tôi rất cao.

definition: not as tall as most people
exampleSentence: I am short, so I can't reach the shelf.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thấp nên không với tới cái kệ.

definition: having little fat on your body
exampleSentence: My cousin is tall and thin.
exampleTranslation: Anh chị em họ của tôi cao và gầy.

definition: weighing too much because you have a lot of flesh
exampleSentence: The cat is getting fat.
exampleTranslation: Con mèo đang béo lên.

definition: attractively thin
exampleSentence: My friend is tall and slim.
exampleTranslation: Bạn tôi cao và thon gọn.

definition: having a lot of physical power
exampleSentence: My dad is strong enough to lift the box.
exampleTranslation: Bố tôi đủ khỏe để nhấc cái hộp.

definition: not physically strong
exampleSentence: I feel weak after being ill.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thấy yếu sau khi ốm.
